windowBasis: [I] Candidate review envelope, not an incident trigger, publication date or proof of receipt. A named act still needs its own source/date. Inherited windows are byte-for-byte unchanged.

facets.recommendation: [I] Carry 0074: captured soldiers leave strength as typed losses; no captor holding or automated return. Black forces require the R2/R4 re-ruling first.
[I] A notice may state cited surrender terms without effects implementing parole/exchange. Missing is not captured; no civilian/teamster capture through force arithmetic.

agencyReasonNotes: [I] No class-required agency reason. Preserve named actors in reports; do not invent a derived mechanic or use absence of a reason as permission to target people.

triggerRules.policy: [I] Whole-word rules from triggerMatches; use the live proper-noun allowlist as well. A match requests review, never assigns a topic automatically. No gate:none approval is supplied.

topicRules: Separate capture, parole, delivery and completed exchange; no return-to-service timer.
Use source-specific ranges only for comparable quantities. No count of protected civilians as captured property.

remaining: Do not extend 1A leave-play silently to Black units; R2/R4 must place their treatment first.
